instruction: Gere um prompt para seedream para criar uma imagem de envelope
prompt:
Ultra-detailed, hyper-realistic cinematic composition featuring a luxurious decorative envelope as the main subject, positioned in the foreground and occupying a strong central presence in the frame. The envelope is elegant, refined and premium, with realistic paper texture, soft matte finish, subtle fibers, delicate folds and precise geometry. The design uses a sophisticated marsala wine and pink color palette, creating a romantic and luxurious visual harmony. The envelope may include fine metallic accents, subtle pearlescent details, a tasteful wax seal, ribbon or ornamental closure, all rendered with tactile realism and exquisite craftsmanship.

The envelope is placed within a rich, story-driven elegant environment, not a flat backdrop. The background forms a refined narrative scene — such as a luxurious floral setting, an upscale romantic interior, or a softly lit elegant evening atmosphere — softly blurred but visually recognizable. Surrounding elements are carefully curated and symbolic, including roses, petals, delicate leaves, glowing dust or soft sparkles, arranged organically around the envelope. These elements feel natural and graceful, enhancing sophistication and visual depth without overpowering the composition.

Lighting is cinematic and graceful, with soft key light illuminating the envelope, delicate rim light outlining its edges, and subtle volumetric light adding dimension. Atmospheric haze and floating particles catch the light, creating a dreamy, elegant and premium mood. Shadows are soft, realistic and directional. The color palette is intentional and harmonious, dominated by marsala wine and pink tones with refined gradients, luminous highlights and controlled contrast, evoking luxury invitation design and editorial photography.

Composition: foreground-focused, envelope sharply in focus, background softly defocused, strong sense of depth and perspective. Camera: macro lens look, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on envelope texture, seal and ornaments, cinematic bokeh in background lights. Style: photorealistic, hyper-detailed, cinematic realism, elegant, luxurious, premium invitation aesthetic. Technical details: 8K ultra-high resolution, realistic materials, global illumination, volumetric lighting, high dynamic range. Aspect ratio: 9:16. Rendering quality: editorial-grade, visually enchanting, suitable for premium invitations and elegant storytelling visuals.
folhaInstruction: Gere um prompt para seedream para criar uma imagem de de uma folha em branco com adornos em torno, sendo essa folha o objeto central e principal da imagem, ocupando quase a tela toda, mas ainda deixando espaço para visualizar o chão, o fundo e os elementos laterais
cartaoPrompt: Gere um cartão na horizontal elegante nessa mesma atmosfera e mesmo tema (Elegante) e mesma paleta de cor (Marsala vinho com pink), escrito apenas Karol, idade 15 Anos.
aberturaInstruction: Crie um prompt de geração de vídeo para essa imagem com a abertura do envelope e um brilho saindo de dentro, no final o brilho vai fazer a tela ficar toda em branco sólido ao aumentar o brilho.
aberturaPrompt:
A animação começa focando em um envelope fechado com um único selo de cera. Assim que o selo de cera se desprende fisicamente e cai no chão, ele não é substituído, duplicado nem regenerado em momento algum. O envelope permanece permanentemente aberto após esse instante, sem que surja qualquer outro selo.
Uma vez removido o selo, a aba do envelope se levanta lentamente. De seu interior, emergem brilhos cintilantes, poeira brilhante e rastros de luz radiante, espalhando-se pelo ambiente em um espetáculo hipnotizante, com feixes mágicos de partículas luminosas que se curvam em torno do envelope, passando à sua frente e por trás em um movimento contínuo. Essas partículas originam-se apenas de dentro do envelope, aumentando em densidade e luminosidade à medida que se deslocam.
A luz radiante se intensifica e se expande para fora, preenchendo gradualmente toda a cena. Nenhum novo objeto físico é introduzido durante essa transição. O brilho intenso dos feixes e das partículas transforma-se em uma tela branca sólida e deslumbrante no quadro final. A câmera aplica um zoom sutil e lento.
aberturaSlide2Prompt: Remove the envelope from the image completely, revealing only the beautiful background scene, keeping all other elements intact. The result should look natural without any envelope.
aberturaSlide3ImagePrompt: Ultra-detailed, hyper-realistic cinematic scene for a debutante celebration, designed as an elegant narrative environment that perfectly matches a luxury invitation aesthetic. The setting is a sophisticated marsala wine and pink themed ballroom or refined reception space, with graceful architectural details, tasteful floral arrangements, and an atmosphere of romantic elegance. The scene is centered on a grand decorative stage or ceremonial backdrop area, featuring rich velvet drapery, delicate gold accents, soft blush lighting, and abundant roses in marsala, wine, and pink tones. Elegant chandeliers or refined ambient fixtures glow softly in the distance, creating a luxurious and dreamy ambiance. Surrounding elements include cascading flowers, rose petals, subtle crystal details, delicate foliage, and soft luminous sparkles arranged organically throughout the environment. The composition feels premium and story-driven, with strong depth, layered scenery, and a visually recognizable event venue, softly blurred in the far background while the central scene remains crisp and refined. Lighting is cinematic and graceful, with soft key illumination, gentle rim light, and subtle volumetric rays enhancing the atmosphere. Atmospheric haze, floating particles, and controlled highlights create a magical, elegant, and high-end mood. The color palette is intentional and harmonious, dominated by marsala wine and pink with touches of champagne gold and soft ivory, evoking sophistication, femininity, and celebration. Style: photorealistic, hyper-detailed, cinematic realism, elegant debutante celebration, premium event design, editorial-grade visual composition. Technical details: 8K ultra-high resolution, realistic materials, global illumination, volumetric lighting, high dynamic range. Aspect ratio: 9:16.
aberturaSlide3AnimPrompt: Cinematic slow-moving animation of an elegant debutante event scene in marsala wine and pink tones. The camera performs a very gentle forward drift with subtle lateral parallax, maintaining a refined, luxurious perspective on the ballroom or ceremonial backdrop. Soft chandeliers and ambient lights shimmer delicately in the distance, while volumetric light rays move almost imperceptibly through a light atmospheric haze. Rose petals, tiny sparkles, and floating dust particles drift gracefully through the air with natural motion. Floral arrangements remain still but softly illuminated as highlights breathe subtly across metallic and crystal details. The motion should feel ethereal, premium, and romantic, with smooth stabilization, no abrupt changes, no people, no text, and no speaking. Emphasize cinematic depth, soft bokeh movement, and a dreamy elegant atmosphere consistent with a luxury debutante invitation aesthetic.
aberturaSlide4Prompt: Remove the envelope from the image completely, revealing only the beautiful background scene, keeping all other elements intact. The result should look natural without any envelope.
